description: Gets the upload URL for a specific part by upload ID and part number with signature verification. This endpoint validates HMAC signatures for URI integrity.

parameters.name: upload_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the upload (file ID).

parameters.name: part_number
parameters.description: Part number for the upload segment.

parameters.name: sig
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature for URI integrity verification.

parameters.name: expires_at
parameters.description: Expiration timestamp (Unix timestamp in seconds). The request will be rejected if this timestamp has expired.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid parameters or expired signature

403.description: Forbidden - The operation is not valid for the current state of the object

404.description: Not Found - Part not found for the specified part number

500.description: Internal Server Error - Failed to retrieve part URL
